t1.text: E11 Console for Mac — today's Mac sidebar, Apple's toolbar, the website inside restyled for the Mac

s3.text:
Decided (Haris 2026-11-14 23:26–23:46, 2026-11-15 09:31): E11 Console for Mac is NOT rebuilt fully native. It stays the website in a window:

THE SIDEBAR — EXACTLY AS TODAY'S MAC APP (Haris 09:31: "sidebar will remain exactly as now"): mac/swift/Sidebar.swift unchanged — the floating glass panel, the window's buttons and the round theme · New task · collapse buttons at its top, the page's rows (Home · Inbox · E11 Day · My Tasks · Content plans · Clients + · Library: Client Assets, Finance, Trash) with their counts, you, Synced, © E11 Agency.

APPLE'S, NEW: the toolbar beside it (the page's name, Talk with its count, Search tasks ⌘K, the E11 mark as today) · right-click menus (only the row's existing actions) · Quick Look. New Task and light / dark stay in the sidebar, so they're not in the toolbar.

THE WEBSITE INSIDE, restyled for the Mac only: Apple's font, Mac table rows, Mac fields / buttons, light / dark with the Mac. Home always one complete page, filling the window, both columns ending on one line.

E11 Talk for Mac stays fully native.

s4.text:
Home checked against the website again (home.js viewLead, Admin): nothing left out — now on the boards: E11 Day and + New task beside the greeting, the chart's running line, Busiest day and dates, Recent activity (Open Inbox), Checklist, Team on time. (An AM sees the same page with its own words: "Your tasks due today", "Your clients' tasks", "My clients".)

NOT YET MOCKED: the other Home — Production, Social and everyone else (home.js viewMember): Up next (Mark my part done / Submit files for review, Open task, Next task →, its checklist), My pipeline, My week, Recent activity, My CD reviews, Amendments to fix, Latest files, On-time streak.

WHAT THE iPHONE HAS AND THE MAC DOESN'T (Home):
1. A task's swipes Due date… and Trash — the Mac's right-click has Open Task, Status, Mark Complete, Copy Link only.
2. Hold a task → Attach Files (Camera, Photos, Files) — nothing on the Mac's Home rows.
3. A task row's CD chip and Urgent / P1 tag, and the overdue row's faint red tint — the Mac's rows show the status pill only.
4. Search finds people too (tasks, clients or people, with "found in") — the Mac's Search tasks ⌘K finds tasks and clients.
5. The iPhone's Home is E11 Day itself (today's tasks by client, then Overdue); on the Mac that's its own page (E11 Day in the sidebar).
